user-story.text: As the pipeline operator I scan consistent status cards and see oracle, agent and cfhal ADA balances. Stale observations are labelled stale rather than healthy. I can expand technical details without long image names crowding the summary.

collection-flow.text: This slice implements current balances, public coordinates, provider validation, exact lovelace arithmetic and stale recovery. Historical expenses, historical address census, locked-fund accounting and independent matching-point validation remain open in issues23/24. It does not close those issues.

The network and role mappings were established in their discovery receipts. GitHub schema validation and provider response validation refuse unknown fields, unsupported networks, missing/duplicated addresses and invalid balances. Raw wallet material is never read by the collector. A failed provider/configuration read retains explicitly stale observations and their original address scope.

verification.text: Known multi-address fixtures check exact sums, including integers beyond JS floating-point precision. Missing addresses and malformed balances refuse. Provider outage preserves last-good time and balance; recovery refreshes both. Rendered cards use the service container rather than its reporter and refuse healthy labels for stale sources. Desktop/mobile light/dark views are inspected.
